इर्व्वारु mf. (-रुः-रुः)
 1. A cucumber, (Cumumis utilatissimus, Rox.)
2. Another kind, (Cucumis colocynthis.)
 E. इरु a seed, and आरु
what goes to or gets, from ऋ and उण् affix, or आलु, र becoming ल;
also written इर्व्वालु, ईर्व्वारु, उर्व्वारु, &c.

ईर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus;) also ईर्व्वालु and
ईर्व्वारु, &c.

इर्व्वारुशुक्तिका f. (-का) A kind of melon; commonly Sphuti or Sphut,
(Cucumis momordica.)
 E. इर्व्वारु and शुक्तिका an oyster-shaped cu-
cumber.
